note: Invented: a three-page app for a bike co-op's tool library.

pages.title: Overview
pages.lead: What is out and what is due back this week.

sections.title: Opening hours
sections.text: Tuesday and Thursday evening, 6 to 8, and the first Saturday of the month from 10.

sections.title: Loan rules
sections.text: Two tools at a time for two weeks. Power tools go out with their charger and a signed card.

sections.title: Deposits
sections.text: Five for a hand tool, twenty for a power tool, returned when the tool is back and works.
